questions.prompt: What does a high temperature do to next-token probabilities?

options.text: Sharpens them so the top choice wins almost every time
Flattens them so less likely tokens get more chances
Adds new facts to the model

questions.explanation: Temperature rescales probabilities before sampling. High values flatten the distribution for more variety; low values sharpen it.

questions.prompt: Which statements are true as of October 2026? Select all that apply.

options.text: Claude API version 2026-10-21 rejects temperature, top_p, and top_k with a 400 error on every model
Google says Gemini 3.6+ and Gemini 4 ignore custom sampling values
OpenAI's Responses API documents temperature between 0 and 2
Every major API requires you to set temperature on every request

questions.explanation: Vendors are moving away from user-set sampling on their newest models, though some APIs still document the parameters. Always check current docs.

questions.prompt: Sampling only from the smallest set of tokens whose probabilities add up to p is called top-p, or ____ sampling.
questions.explanation: Nucleus (top-p) sampling trims unlikely tokens. Change it or temperature, not both.

questions.prompt: Summaries in your app sometimes end mid-word. The logged stop reason is max_tokens. What's the best fix?

options.text: Raise the cap and ask for a length in the prompt, and keep checking the stop reason

questions.explanation: The cap truncates. Ask for brevity in words or bullet points, keep the cap as a safety net, and catch truncations through the stop reason.

questions.prompt: Match each control to what it really does.

pairs.right: Sharpens or flattens the probability distribution
Truncates the response at a limit
Ends generation when a marker appears
Controls how much a reasoning model thinks and spends

questions.explanation: Each control acts at a different point: token choice, length cap, a stop marker, or reasoning depth.

questions.prompt: Your old code sends temperature 0 and now fails after an API upgrade. Order the migration steps.

items.text: Run your test set at the defaults and compare
Remove the sampling parameter from the request
Move consistency requirements into the prompt, examples, and schema
Add validation and retries for outputs that drift

questions.explanation: Remove the parameter, measure what changed, rebuild consistency in the prompt and schema, then guard with validation.
